description: Persona smoke expectations for 'dunkin' (Rick's PR #108 second review: moved out of shared C# -- tests/conformance/tests/Conformance.Tests/PersonaSmokeTests.cs -- so no brand-specific literal lives there; a data-only pack PR adds only this file). Loaded by PersonaSmokeExpectations.For(personaId). Every field must be sourced from this SAME persona's own pack files, never invented: greetingSubstring from personas/dunkin/prompts/greeting.yaml, and searchableOwnItem/orderableItemName/orderableItemSize/orderableItemPrice from personas/dunkin/menu/menuItems.json (the size/price pair must match that file's entry exactly, or the add-to-order smoke step fails). orderableItemName names 'Glazed Donut' (Donuts & Bakery, happyHourDiscounted:false) rather than a Signature Latte or Cold Beverage item, since PersonaSmokeTests.cs asserts the charged price equals this exact menu price and the smoke fixtures run on the real wall clock (not a FixedClock), so a happy-hour-eligible item's price could vary depending on when the suite runs. Refs #127 (closes the gap this file used to flag as known-but-out-of-scope): happyHour (eligibleItem/size/menuPrice, ineligibleItem/ineligibleSize/ineligibleMenuPrice, all from this SAME pack's own menu/menuItems.json) is loaded by RealPackHappyHourConformanceTests.cs's PersonaHappyHourSmokeExpectations.For(personaId, isEnabled) and proves this pack's own inside/outside-window discount+banner behavior end to end -- eligibleItem must have happyHourDiscounted:true, ineligibleItem must not. testdata/personas/dunkin/golden-menu-categories.json and golden-order-pricing.json (added preemptively per #79, never consumed by any C# fixture) were removed rather than wired into this Theory: their businessRules block only duplicated this pack's own persona.json (a second, driftable source of truth for the exact fields this Theory now reads directly), their happyHourBoundaryInstants/DST-matrix richness exceeds what #127 requires (one inside/one outside instant per pack -- the fuller DST-boundary matrix remains scoped to a single other, unrelated pack's own dedicated test files, which this pack never had an equivalent of either), and their taxCases/sizeDisplayCases/sizeNotAvailableCases/extrasCases sections are a materially larger conformance surface (tax, size-display, extras/category gating) than 'happy-hour conformance' -- out of #127's stated scope and better tracked as its own future issue/PR if wanted.
greetingSubstring: Welcome to Dunkin! How may I help you today?
